notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Metastatic Evangel trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
